Chat request with response_format json_schema that validates the output structure

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the temperature in Paris today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"json_schema\":{\"name\":\"weather\",\"schema\":{\"properties\":{\"temp\":{\"type\":\"number\"}},\"required\":[\"temp\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"json_schema\"}}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
